name: OrderPost — Instagram/flyer post → live order page
what_it_does: Upload an existing Instagram/Facebook post, flyer, or menu screenshot; AI extracts items/prices/pickup; share a single order link (no catalog builder). Drop/instant/approval modes.
how_competitors_use_it: Home bakers / preorder kitchens convert viral posts into ordered revenue without Shopify or DoorDash — closest social-post→order peer to Never86 love→buy-now.
what_we_use_today: script-draft + catalog-sync for TikTok/IG Shop rails (Franklin sandbox).
gap: Watch closely. Contrast: OrderPost closes via hosted order link from a post; Never86 closes in-app Shop / buy-now on cult chef brands. Cite in script-draft outreach when DM-preorder pain appears.
summary: Top new social-post→order rival. Sharpens buy-now wedge narrative vs DM chaos and marketplace rent.
